Saddle up, Pasco — Beah Hazard's birthday is turning into the biggest glitter stampede of the year 🦄✨ My Little Drag Show is galloping onto Azucar with debuting diva Twilight taking the reins as host, and she's bringing a whole kingdom with her: Dominic Tex, Puddlexxz, Cherry Pop, Night Haven Rexia, and Zero Stars all serving numbers big enough to shake the clouds loose. This isn't just a show, it's a birthday takeover — cake, chaos, and manes for days. Mark it, set reminders, tell your group chat, because this lineup only happens once and December 3rd is the night it drops. Get there early, la pista fills fast when there's this much magic in the building 🎂💅

🗓️ Thursday, December 3 • Doors 7PM / Show 8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $10
🔞 18+

Glitter in the air, bass in your chest, and cake frosting flying somewhere near the stage 🎂🌈 Picture it: lights dipped in pastel pink, Twilight hosting her debut like she was born for the mic, and a lineup — Dominic Tex, Puddlexxz, Cherry Pop, Night Haven Rexia, Zero Stars — turning Azucar into a full-blown fantasy. Birthday energy hits different when it's Beah Hazard's night, the whole room feels like it's floating, manes flying, heels clacking against la pista like confetti falling in rhythm. You can already feel the heat before you even walk in — that electric little buzz that says tonight's going to be unforgettable. Bring your appetite for spectacle because this one's dripping in sparkle and sugar 💖✨

Twilight hosts her debut with a full lineup ready to celebrate alongside you: Dominic Tex, Puddlexxz, Cherry Pop, Night Haven Rexia, and Zero Stars bringing the kind of energy that makes strangers feel like family by the end of the night. Bring your people, bring the love, and let's make Beah's birthday one for the books 💕
